FinMind Free only equivalent remaining gaps

eligibility.monthly_direct: OHLCV, current price, volume, turnover, one-day returns using September consecutive sessions, 5d/10d/20d trailing windows only where sufficient valid consecutive September sessions; daily institutional flow, margin, foreign holdings, official valuation, TDCC four weekly observations
eligibility.monthly_report_self_contained: September revenue current, prior-month and prior-year comparisons from original monthly reporting fields (once release date reached); cannot assume published on 2026-09-30
eligibility.only_if_published_within_asof: official 2026 September report 2026 October publication; NDC 11509 October 29 workbook; financial revisions need available_at
eligibility.correctly_not_applicable: MA60/120/240, RS60/120/240, historical 50/120/240 breakout, multiyear percentile, 24m revenue peak, EPS TTM and seasonal QoQ without prerequisite history, 57 XQ-dependent indicators if source absent
eligibility.missing_policy: NOT_APPLICABLE_HISTORY rather than failed / missing; for truly expected current month fields use NULL + DATA_GAP and quality issue
eligibility.acceptance_split: MONTH_SCOPE_DATA_QA and HISTORICAL_PIT_QA are independent; no claim old backtesting PIT pass

issue_register.rule: do not call all errors; classify trading state and positive volume (previous audit 255) independently
classify official no-trade and exceptions, keep null; do not average across gaps
month 2026-09 revenue publication is after report month; usable in 2026-11-06 descriptive snapshot but not assumed valid at 2026-09-30
check existing native copy gate and 4 weekly Silver partitions; do not block independent families
exclude emerging from Gold analysis and certify TSE/OTC security identity where needed

pass_conditions.bronze: all defined September source-date files for active month-only features exist and checksum/source contracts match or explicit exceptions
pass_conditions.silver: typed, units, dates, key uniqueness, source-SHA equality, null exceptions and row-count QA pass for the monthly dataset
pass_conditions.gold: monthly-eligible formula/columns have non-null values where inputs valid and month window sufficient; no unexplained missing values, no lookahead
pass_conditions.AI: read the verified monthly-only Gold partitions using an accessible query executor, return availability/missing reason and source lineage
